title: Predicting inferior vena cava filter complications using machine learning
summary: Primary Methods/Results use 14,476 patients in VQI; 70/30 train/test split predicts one-year IVC-filter complications. XGBoost AUROC 0.93 versus logistic regression 0.63. Retrospective registry validation and dataset-specific risk prediction only. This record is limited to the study result and does not establish independent replication or real-world benefit.
